spec.description: Telemetry liveness: the agent exports every 60 s; above 3 means the pipeline is down or the server is.
spec.title: Minutes since last metric sample

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (resource) (label_replace(
last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"/fhir/[A-Z].*"}[$__range])
 - (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"/fhir/[A-Z].*"} offset $__range
 or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"/fhir/[A-Z].*"}[$__range]) * 0),
"resource", "$1", "http_route", "/fhir/([A-Z][A-Za-z]+)(/.*)?"))))

spec.description: Requests per FHIR resource type in the selected time range.
spec.title: Resource interactions

spec.expr:
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (http_route) (
last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~".*/[$].*"}[$__range])
 - (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~".*/[$].*"} offset $__range
 or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~".*/[$].*"}[$__range]) * 0))))
